_comment: Copy this to accounts.json (GITIGNORED) to hold MULTIPLE named accounts per social platform for the hub's <prefix>_account_* tools (ig / tt / fb / wa). Social logins are FILE-based: an account's 'files' map points a slot at THAT account's session/cookie file (or directory). Switching/cycling makes the backend load that file -- either via a path env var the backend honours (insta: INSTA_DATA_DIR -> a directory holding session.json; fb: FB_COOKIES_PATH -> a cookies.json file) or, for WhatsApp (fixed auth_info/, no env override), by COPYING the account's auth_info dir onto that path before respawn. 'env' values may be literal secrets OR ${ENV} refs resolved from the hub's environment at spawn time -- prefer ${ENV} refs so this file stays secret-free (file PATHS are local, not secrets). Slot keys: insta='session', fb='cookies', wa='auth'. tiktok is keyless (env-only, no files). Any platform omitted here simply has no configured accounts and the backend uses its own default session file.
